# Heuristic structural check. The ground truth (real group rating data) is not available,
# so this only tests the submitted answer for internal consistency against a stated assumption.
# Assumption: the five widely acclaimed, mainstream dramas/epics are mutually "similar";
# Manic, Easter Parade and Captain America are the odd ones out
# (obscure indie / classic musical / superhero).

options = {
 "A": ["Schindler's List","The Shawshank Redemption","Braveheart","Captain America The First Avenger","Dances with Wolves"],
 "B": ["Manic","The Shawshank Redemption","Dances with Wolves","Braveheart","Pulp Fiction"],
 "C": ["Manic","Pulp Fiction","Schindler's List","The Shawshank Redemption","Dances with Wolves"],
 "D": ["The Shawshank Redemption","Pulp Fiction","Captain America The First Avenger","Schindler's List","Manic"],
 "E": ["Pulp Fiction","Schindler's List","Dances with Wolves","The Shawshank Redemption","Braveheart"],
 "F": ["Dances with Wolves","Schindler's List","Easter Parade","Pulp Fiction","The Shawshank Redemption"],
 "G": ["Braveheart","Pulp Fiction","Dances with Wolves","Schindler's List","Captain America The First Avenger"],
 "H": ["Braveheart","Easter Parade","Manic","Dances with Wolves","Captain America The First Avenger"],
 "I": ["Schindler's List","Braveheart","Dances with Wolves","Manic","Easter Parade"],
 "J": ["Schindler's List","The Shawshank Redemption","Easter Parade","Manic","Dances with Wolves"],
}
odd = {"Manic","Easter Parade","Captain America The First Avenger"}

scores = {k: sum(m in odd for m in v) for k, v in options.items()}
for k in sorted(scores):
    print(k, "outliers:", scores[k])

best = min(scores.values())
winners = sorted(k for k, s in scores.items() if s == best)
print("Best (fewest outliers):", winners)

# Submitted answer names A, E, J as most aligned and also D as a strong contender
submitted = {"A", "E", "J", "D"}
print("Submitted names:", sorted(submitted))
print("Outlier counts of submitted names:", {k: scores[k] for k in sorted(submitted)})

committed_single = len(submitted) == 1
consistent = committed_single and submitted == set(winners)
print("Commits to a single option:", committed_single)
print("Consistent with heuristic winner:", consistent)
print("Note: this check relies on an assumption, not ground-truth rating data.")

if consistent:
    print("CHECK PASS")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
